dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: We'll leave soon. My apologies if we've disturbed your adventure.

choices.text: About the collaboration with the Millelith...

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: That was a long time ago. Shortly after this place was locked down, we contacted the Liyue Qixing.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: At first, things went smoothly... Signora even nailed a few mutually beneficial trade agreements.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: And one of the additional conditions was that Liyue would allow the Fatui to send an advance team into The Chasm... We came to investigate and eradicate the source of the anomalies.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: As agreed, Snezhnaya and Liyue would share whatever we were to find down here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't you have other purposes?

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: At least none that I'm aware of. When we entered The Chasm, the local citizens even sent us their best wishes. We all thought... that we would be heroes, sacrificing ourselves for the sake of others.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: *sigh*... Who'd have thought things would turn out like this?

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: "Dark Calamity," "the Calamity of Darkness," or whatever you call it... They all mean the great disaster that occurred five hundred years ago.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: Anyway, it's the eternal enemy of Snezhnaya... For five hundred years, the calamity has been lurking in the dark and we'll be on guard forever.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: About us? There's nothing much to talk about... We fought hard and we failed. That's all.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: When we first came down, we were the Ninth Company, a company of 64 soldiers. But now, I guess half of our men including our commander have either gone missing or died... Well, maybe not yet half of us...

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: But anyway, it's around that figure. We've been scattered and lost contact with each other... We lost this battle and should've retreated long ago.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But your people on the ground attacked Liyue Harbor.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: ...It's surprising but I think I can understand why.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: To assist in endeavors of greater meaning, Lord Pulcinella won't hesitate to dispense with less valuable assets. That's his logic.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: As his direct subordinate, I have no objections to his cause of action...

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: Did you meet her? Is she still alive? I hope she can forgive me.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: Katarina and her younger brother, Kapral Nikolay, were brought up in the House of the Hearth. They are the children of Her Majesty the Tsaritsa.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: She told me that she was going to find her brother. I thought she lost her mind having stayed in the environment down here... There's no way that her brother could live.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: Abandon? No, she... she volunteered to stay. After all, unnecessary obsessions only slow the whole team down.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: We... We're prepared to sacrifice our lives or the lives of our loved ones for all... This is the resolution of the Fatui.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: Katya is no exception, nor is Kolya.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: I wouldn't blame them if they did the same to me.

choices.text: The situation she's in is not so bad as you think.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: You're an outsider. The Fatui can't and shouldn't get sentimental in front of civilians.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: But to her, we're family. She's — she was — also our family.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: But she insisted on looking for Kolya... I hope she can forgive me.
